prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Chinese woman — the personification of Beijing — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Beijing as her world knows it — a city of an imperial Chinese myth-world: vermilion-lacquered wood and carved white stone, roofs of glazed tile, latticed paper windows, glowing painted beams, silk, lantern-light and drifting cloud-shaped lights, blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the palace roofs, the temple hall or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a packed rune-lit carriage of the great tunnels beneath the capital at rush hour — carved wooden benches, bronze hand-rails, glowing route-runes along the ceiling and travellers in robes pressed shoulder to shoulder.
Around her, as her world makes them: a wax-sealed travel token; an embroidered silk pouch on a braided cord; a leather-bound book with gilt edges; lantern-orbs of soft magical light floating overhead.
Season: winter — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: the morning rush hour — low clean sunlight and the city's crowd hurrying to work; morning light slanting through the window across the floor.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.
Outfit: a short white lab coat worn open over a cropped knit top and a pencil mini skirt; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather and other heavy materials stay opaque; right now — she wears her top half undone — the zip or the top buttons open much lower than usual, so the neckline falls open over her collarbones and the inner curve of her chest, the loose edges slipping apart, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the right of the frame; head turned with her body, the tip of her nose pointing toward the right of the frame; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she raises a brass-bound memory glass that keeps a captured image to her eye to take a photo — her own right hand on the grip, finger on the shutter, her own left hand supports the lens from below.
LEGS: weight even on both legs.
GAZE: one eye is set close to the eyepiece or viewfinder of what she holds, looking through it.
EXPRESSION: slightly furrowed brow, softened eyes, lips lightly pressed together.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper.
